description: N Act To Establish The Mississippi Energy Security And Agricultural Growth Act; To Define Permissible Sources Of Clean And Renewable Energy To Include Advanced Natural Gas And Renewable Natural Gas; To Provide For The Protection Of Ratepayer Affordability; To Empower Agricultural Producers To Contribute To The State's Energy Grid; And For Related Purposes.

title: Division of Medicaid; prohibit from collecting monies owed due to overpayments from a Greenwood hospital until after May 1, 2026.
description: An Act To Prohibit The Division Of Medicaid From Collecting Or Taking Any Steps To Collect Monies Owed Due To Overpayments Received During The 2024 Fiscal Year From A Hospital In Greenwood Until After May 1, 2026, In Order To Ensure That Access To Critical Health Care Services Will Not Be Eroded Or Eliminated For Central And Eastern Regions Of The Mississippi Delta; And For Related Purposes.

title: Appropriation; additional for MEMA for purposes authorized under the Disaster Assistance Trust Fund.
description: An Act Making An Additional Appropriation Of Disaster Assistance Trust Funds To The Mississippi Emergency Management Agency For The Purposes Of Defraying Expenses Related To The State Obligations For Disaster Response And Recovery, Including The Severe Weather Event Beginning On January 24, 2026, For The Period Beginning Upon Passage Of This Act, And Ending June 30, 2027.

title: City of Starkville; extend repeal date on economic development, tourism/convention tax.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 950, Local And Private Laws Of 1994, As Last Amended By Chapter 905, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, To Extend The Repeal Date On The City Of Starkville's Economic Development, Tourism And Convention Tax; And For Related Purposes.

title: City of Richland; extend date of repeal on hotel/motel tourism tax.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 906, Local And Private Laws Of 2018, As Amended By Chapter 904, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, To Extend The Date Of Repeal On The Provision Of Law That Authorizes The Governing Authorities Of The City Of Richland, Mississippi, To Levy A 3% Tax Upon The Gross Proceeds Of Room Rentals From Hotels And Motels Within The City For The Purpose Of Promoting Tourism And Parks And Recreation; And For Related Purposes.

title: City of Richland; extend repealer on bar and restaurant tourism tax.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 938, Local And Private Laws Of 1998, As Last Amended By Chapter 903, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, To Extend The Repealer On The Provision Of Law That Authorizes The Governing Authorities Of The City Of Richland, Mississippi, To Impose A Tax Upon The Gross Sales Of Bars And Restaurants In An Amount Not To Exceed Two Percent For The Purpose Of Providing Funds For The Promotion Of Tourism, Parks And Recreation Within The City; And For Related Purposes.

title: Lamar County; authorize to employ part-time county prosecuting attorney as full-time elected official.
description: An Act To Authorize The Board Of Supervisors Of Lamar County, Mississippi, To Employ The Part-time County Prosecuting Attorney As A Full-time Elected Official During His Or Her Term Of Office And To Prescribe The Compensation For Such Attorney; And For Related Purposes.

title: City of Horn Lake; extend the repeal date on the tax on hotel and motel room rentals.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 922, Local And Private Laws Of 2013, As Last Amended By Chapter 938, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, To Extend The Repeal Date On The Law That Authorizes The Governing Authorities Of The City Of Horn Lake, Mississippi, To Levy A Tax Upon Hotel And Motel Room Rentals, Which Shall Be Used To Promote The City's Tourism And Economic Development; And For Related Purposes.

title: City of Southaven; extend repeal date on restaurant tax.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 955, Local And Private Laws Of 2011, As Last Amended By Chapter 933, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, To Extend The Repeal Date On The Law That Authorizes The City Of Southaven, Mississippi, To Impose A Tax Upon The Gross Proceeds Of Sales Of Beverages And Prepared Food At Restaurants Within The City; And For Related Purposes.

title: City of Natchez and Adams County; extend repealer on, and revise amounts of, authority to contribute annually to Natchez, Inc.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 901, Local And Private Laws Of 2022, By Extending The Date Of Repeal From July 1, 2026, To July 1, 2030, On The Provision Of Law That Authorizes The Governing Authorities Of The City Of Natchez, Mississippi, And The Board Of Supervisors Of Adams County, Mississippi, To Contribute Funds To Natchez, Inc., A Mississippi Nonprofit Corporation Organized For Economic Development Purposes; To Revise Contribution Limits; And For Related Purposes.

title: Noxubee County; extend repealer on assessments on misdemeanor convictions and nonadjudications for capital improvements.
description: An Act To Amend Chapter 903, Local And Private Laws Of 2021, To Extend The Repealer On The Authority Of The Board Of Supervisors Of Noxubee County, Mississippi, To Levy An Assessment, In Addition To Any Other Assessments And Court Costs, For Civil Cases Filed And Misdemeanor Convictions And/or Nonadjudications Obtained In Its Justice Court, To Be Placed In A Special County Fund Designated The "noxubee County Capital Improvements Fund" And Used To Fund Capital Improvements; And For Related Purposes.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to City of Tupelo to construct a new fire station and emergency command center.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Tupelo For The Purpose Of Defraying Expenses Related To The Construction Of A New Fire Station And Emergency Command Center For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to MDA for the Small Municipalities and Limited Population Counties Grant Program.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Mississippi Development Authority For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Small Municipalities And Limited Population Counties Grant Program For The Fiscal Year 2027.

description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Mississippi Home Corporation For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Small Municipalities And Limited Population Counties Grant Program For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Tupelo City School District for security screening on windows and doors.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Tupelo City School District For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With A Pilot Program To Purchase Security Screening For All Windows And Doors On Tupelo High School Campus For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: Capital Expense Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Clay County for Waverly Road.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Clay County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Repair, Paving, And Improvements To Waverly Road For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: Capital Expense Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Clay County for improvements to certain roads.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Clay County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Repair, Paving, And Improvements To Good Road, Pruitt Road, And Roads In Supervisor District 3 For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Hinds County for construction of a community center and park in Pocahontas.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Hinds County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Construction Of A Community Center And Park In The Unincorporated Community Of Pocahontas For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to DMH for additional ID/DD Home- and Community-Based Waiver slots and additional staff.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Department Of Mental Health For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Additional Id/dd Home- And Community-based Waiver Slots And Additional Staff To Support Such Slots For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the Yazoo County Convention and Visitors Bureau for the restoration of certain property.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Yazoo County Convention And Visitors Bureau For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Preservation And Restoration Of The Manchester Historic Property Located In Yazoo County For The Fiscal Year 2027.

description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Town Of Anguilla, Mississippi For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Renovation Of Its Town Hall And Construction Of A Multipurpose Facility For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to City of Pearl for the renovation of its city hall.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Pearl, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Renovation Of Its City Hall For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Harrison County for U.S.ighway 49 corridor improvements.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Harrison County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Corridor Improvement From U.s. Highway 49 West To The Intersection Of West Wortham Road/robinwood Drive And Old Highway 49 Intersection Along West Wortham Road In Harrison County For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to City of Wiggins for sewer infrastructure improvements.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Wiggins, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Sewer Infrastructure Improvements From U.s. Highway 49 To The West Lagoon For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Greenwood Cemetery Association for restoration and repair.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Greenwood Cemetery Association For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Restoration And Repair Of The Cemetery For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the Town of Bude, Mississippi, for the purchase of police vehicles, cameras and equipment.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Town Of Bude, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Purchase Of Police Vehicles, Cameras And Equipment For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to City of Pearl for installation of traffic signal at intersection of MS-468 and Murray Drive.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Pearl, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Traffic Signal Installation At The Intersection Of Murray Drive And State Highway 468 For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Clay County for the repair and renovation of its county courthouse.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Clay County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Repair And Renovation Of Its County Courthouse For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Clinton/Raymond/Bolton Regional Wastewater project.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Clinton/raymond/bolton Wastewater Authority For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Construction And Development Of The Clinton/raymond/bolton Regional Wastewater Project That Will Transport Treated Wastewater From The Members' Municipal Lagoons And Treatment Facilities To The Big Black River For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to VFW Post 9832 for infrastructure needs.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Vfw Post 9832 For The Purpose Of Defraying The Costs Of The Construction, Repair And/or Renovation Of Certain Infrastructure For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027; appropriation to City of Saltillo for construction of new fire station.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Saltillo For The Purpose Of Defraying Expenses Related To The Construction Of A New Fire Station For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to VFW Post 4057 in Tupelo for renovations.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Vfw Post 4057 In The City Of Tupelo, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying The Costs Associated With Repairs And Renovations To The Post For Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Lee County for renovation of polling precinct and Pratt's Community Center property.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation Of General Funds To Lee County To Defray Expenses Associated With The Renovation Of The Polling Precinct At Pratts Community Center And With The Improvement To Pratts Community Center Property, For Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the City of Magee for the city police department for the acquisition of vehicles and equipment.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Magee For The City Police Department For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Acquisition Of Vehicles And Equipment For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the Town of Monticello for a new Pearl River retaining wall.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Town Of Monticello, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Construction Of A New Pearl River Retaining Wall At Cooper's Ferry Park For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the Town of Monticello for improvements to city facilities.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Town Of Monticello, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Improvements To A Certain Building Purchased For Use As City Hall, A Police Department Annex, And Courtroom Space For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to D'Lo for repairs to the D'Lo Community House, streets, and water systems.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Town Of D'lo, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Repair And Improvements To The D'lo Community House, Street Repair, And Water System Repair For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Mercy House Adult and Teen Challenge for improvements and additions to certain facilities.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Mercy House Adult And Teen Challenge For The Purpose Of Defraying Expenses Related To The Development Of Improvements And Additions To The Mercy House Adult And Teen Challenge Campus In Georgetown, Mississippi, The Planned Location Of The Mercy House Adult And Teen Challenge Short-term Drug And Alcohol Rehabilitation Center In Learned, Mississippi, And For The Acquisitions Of And Improvements To Mercy House Adult And Teen Challenge Third Phase And Aftercare Transitional Phase Residential Houses And Facilities Throughout Mississippi For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Washington County for construction of a new animal shelter.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Washington County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With The Design, Construction And Equipping Of A New Animal Shelter For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the City of Yazoo for renovation of a building to be used as the Boys and Girls Club.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Yazoo, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Renovation Of A Building And Improvements To Its Parking Lot To Be Used As The Boys And Girls Club For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the City of Crystal Springs for toilet facilities at the Chautauqua Amphitheater.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Crystal Springs For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Construction Of Toilet Facilities At The Chautauqua Amphitheater For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to the City of Crystal Springs for construction of the Chautauqua Amphitheater.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Crystal Springs For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Construction Of The Chautauqua Amphitheater, Including The Stage For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Mississippi's Toughest Kids Foundation for certain construction costs at Camp Kamassa.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Mississippi's Toughest Kids Foundation For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Design, Preplanning, Construction, Furnishing And Equipping Of Buildings And Related Facilities At Camp Kamassa In Copiah County, Mississippi, For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Simpson County for road repair.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To Simpson County For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Road Repair For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Georgetown, Mississippi, for repair and construction of infrastructure.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The Town Of Georgetown, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Sidewalk Repair And Replacement, Walking Trail Construction, And Infrastructure Repair For The Fiscal Year 2027; And For Related Purposes.

title: General Fund; FY2027 appropriation to Mendenhall, Mississippi, for repairs to water and sewer infrastructure.
description: An Act Making An Appropriation To The City Of Mendenhall, Mississippi, For The Purpose Of Defraying Costs Associated With Improving Water And Sewer Infrastructure For The Fiscal Year 2027.

title: Tax credits; provide against income or ad valorem taxes for voluntary cash contributions to rural hospitals.

title: Income tax; implement pilot program authorizing credit for educational expenses, awarded by lottery system.

title: Inventory tax; eliminate, and reimburse lost revenue to local governments through legislative appropriations.
description: An Act To Amend Section 27-31-1, Mississippi Code Of 1972, To Exempt From Ad Valorem Taxation The Entire Assessed Value Of Commodities, Raw Materials, Works-in-process, Products, Goods, Wares And Merchandise Held For Resale By A Manufacturer, Distributor, Wholesale Or Retail Merchant; To Provide That Such Assessed Value May Be Determined By Physical Count Or Book Value, At The Option Of The Manufacturer, Distributor, Wholesale Or Retail Merchant; To Exempt From Ad Valorem Taxation The Entire Assessed Value Of Eligible Personal Property That Is Owned By A Business Enterprise And Used By The Business Enterprise Solely On The Premises Of The Business Enterprise In The Operation Of The Enterprise; To Specify That "eligible Personal Property" Means Furniture, Fixtures Or Equipment Classified As Personal Property For Purposes Of Ad Valorem Taxation But Does Not Include Motor Vehicles Or Class Iv Property As Defined In Section 112 Of The Mississippi Constitution Of 1890; To Create A New Code Section To Express The Intent Of The Legislature That Any Loss Of Revenue Incurred By A County, Municipality, Or School District Resulting From The Elimination Of The Inventory Tax Be Reimbursed To The Respective Local Government Entity Through Legislative Appropriation; To Require That The Amount Of County, Municipal And School District Inventory Tax That Would Have Been Levied Be Certified To The Department Of Revenue, Which Shall Compile The Data And Report It To The Legislature No Later Than November 1 Of Each Year; To Authorize The Department Of Revenue To Promulgate Rules And Regulations To Administer These Reporting Provisions; To Bring Forward Section 27-7-22.5, Mississippi Code Of 1972, Which Provides An Income Tax Credit For Ad Valorem Taxes Paid On Commodities, Raw Materials, Works-in-process, Products, Goods, Wares And Merchandise Held For Resale By Any Manufacturer, Distributor, Wholesale Or Retail Merchant, For The Purpose Of Possible Amendment; To Bring Forward Section 27-35-15, Mississippi Code Of 1972, Which Provides The Method Of Assessing Personal Property, For The Purpose Of Possible Amendment; And For Related Purposes.

description: An Act To Amend Section 57-105-1, Mississippi Code Of 1972, To Authorize The Governor Of Mississippi To Designate One Or More Counties Of The State As Eligible Recovery Zones In Response To The State Of Emergency Declared By The Governor On January 22, 2026, For The Purpose Of Qualified Equity Investment Income Tax And Insurance Premium Tax Credits; To Provide That Such Authority Shall Expire After June 30, 2027; To Provide That, Through June 30, 2027, A Qualified Community Development Entity May Make A Qualified Low-income Community Investment In A Business, And Such Business Shall Qualify As A Qualified Active Low-income Community Business, Even If Not Located In A Low-income Community, If It Is Located In A Recovery Zone And Otherwise Satisfies The Requirements Of The Section, And An Executive Officer Of Such Business Certifies That The Qualified Low-income Community Investment Will Be Used For Recovery From The State Of Emergency; And For Related Purposes.

title: Bonds; authorize revenue bonds to be issued to pay for damage to electric utilities caused by 2026 winter storm.
description: An Act To Enact The Mississippi 2026 Severe Winter Storm Electric Utility Customer Relief And Electric Utility System Restoration Act; To Establish A Mechanism By Which The Mississippi Public Service Commission May Authorize And Certify An Electric Utility Financing Order And The State May Issue Bonds To Pay The Costs Of Repairing Damage To The Systems Of Electric Utilities Caused By The 2026 Winter Storm; To Authorize Electric Utilities To Petition The Public Service Commission For The Issuance Of A Financing Order Which, When Transmitted To The State Bond Commission By An Electric Utility, Authorizes The Issuance Of Bonds To Pay The Costs Associated With Restoring The System Of The Electric Utility; To Provide The Contents Of Such A Petition; To Authorize The Public Utilities Staff To Conduct An Independent Investigation Of The Petition; To Establish The Duties Of The Public Service Commission With Regard To Such Petitions; To Provide For The Contents Of Financing Orders; To Provide That The Financing Order Shall Require The Electric Utility To Collect A System Restoration Charge From Its Retail Customers Sufficient To Pay The Debt Service On Any Bonds Issued Pursuant To The Financing Order; To Provide For Annual Adjustments To The System Restoration Charges To Ensure That The Charges Are Sufficient To Pay The Debt Service On Any Bonds Issued Pursuant To This Act; To Provide The Method For Appealing Decisions Of The Public Service Commission With Respect To A Financing Order; To Provide For The Duration Of A Financing Order; To Authorize The Issuance Of Bonds In An Amount Not To Exceed The Amount Specified In The Financing Order To Be Utilized By An Electric Utility To Pay The Cost Of Repairs Necessitated By The 2026 Winter Storm; To Authorize The Creation Of Sinking Funds Into Which System Restoration Charges Collected By The Electric Utility Shall Be Deposited And To Provide That Money In The Sinking Funds Shall Be Utilized To Pay The Debt Service On Bonds Issued Pursuant To A Financing Order; To Bring Forward Section 77-3-2, Mississippi Code Of 1972, For The Purpose Of Possible Amendment; And For Related Purposes.
